channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Nidec unable to obtain auditor’s opinion on fiscal 2025 report by end of October
item.description: The motor manufacturer, mired in an accounting scandal, is unable to complete procedures sought by audit firm PwC Japan Group.

item.title: Airbus ready for linkup with GCAP, CEO says
item.description: Joining the British-Japanese-Italian consortium to build a next-generation fighter jet is an option after the collapse of a Franco-German rival.

item.title: Hawks complete sweep against BayStars to repeat as Japan Series champions
item.description: The Hawks won their ninth Japan Series title since 2011 and their eighth since 2014 to bolster their status as one of the top dynasties in NPB history.

item.title: Russia claims consular meeting for detained Japan reporter held promptly
item.description: A consular meeting between embassy officials and the Hokkaido Shimbun reporter took place nearly two weeks after he was detained.

item.title: Chipotle now has more demand from lower-income diners than higher-income ones
item.description: The fast-casual chain says menu-price increases helped results. It also noted rising beef costs and “higher protein usage” as people try to find ways to pack more protein into their diets.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
